environment: Native original DLL called through Wine 11.17 with native MSVC dependencies and Wine builtin UCRT/OS services.
explicit_limits: Typed int groups compare only lower32 value bits and do not read upper stack bytes.
Pointer values are opaque and are never dereferenced.
Double and pointer groups use fully initialized eight-byte values.
init.created and close.completed are event metadata, not integer return values.
The sorted comparator compares low-byte keys and records existing/candidate order.
omitted_artifacts: The reference C caller and executable remain in the root evidence packet. This fixture copies only the immutable records and manifest. No reference program code is ported into the Rust application.
